description: Trading analytics of one NFT collection over the last 7, 30, 90 or 365 days: sales, volume (ADA), distinct buyers and sellers per day and in total, creator royalties paid (only over sales whose royalty is recorded, with the coverage), volume by wallet size (wallets grouped by how many NFTs they bought or sold in the window) and the top traders. Sales whose buyer and seller are the same wallet are left out and counted in `excluded`.

policyId.description: NFT policy id: 56 hex characters. Get it from `search` or `list_nft_collections`.
